verdict

followed
Yes. 177 recommendations over ten reports: 141 taken (16 of them partial), 2 overtaken, 1 repeated-only, 33 open - 80 %. The ninth report's 19 were 15 taken (5 partial) and 4 open within a day: 11 in PR #201 the same night and 4 more on this branch. What is taken is mechanical - readers, launchers, gates, consolidations, documents - and it is taken fast (median 0.15 days between merges; every report's fixes in the next one to three PRs).
moved_the_scoreboard
Barely, and not by the reports' own asks. Goal count: 0 of 12 (F32 result, 9 Sep) -> 2 of 12 (F35 result, 14 Sep). The two modes that entered - car and motorbike - did so on the footpath network and the engines' routing (R7.20 was the one model-side recommendation that opened a family on its own), while every mode-side control the reports asked for (raptor mode cost, service quality, submode alternatives, score MSA, crowding's absent control) is built and unrun. Gates fired since the first report: 6 of the series' 25; arms to horizon: 2. The reports' measurable effect is on the instruments (the counts rung, the choice-set bound, the fit record on a stopped arm, the reader's schedule), and on what is refused (heap, stall, no-op overlay, concurrent arm).
what_keeps_not_being_taken
Four things, all needing something other than a code change: the TfNSW request (drafted twice, never sent - five consecutive reports), the replication band (six reports; a seed arm has not run since F4 on 21 Aug), a second reviewer or a required status check (three reports; 0 reviews on 70 PRs; the ruleset requires a PR and nothing else), and the population-synthesis lane of R2 (0 of 7 taken). The recurring-only recommendation is the one that costs an external party or machine hours the operator has not approved.
cadence
The rule since 11 Sep is once per reading (a gate, a horizon, a rebuild). Ten reports in eleven days against 15 readings; four on 7 Sep. The ninth (14 Sep 01:41) followed the F34 rebuild and the F35 opening - allowed by the letter - while F35's arm 0 stood at iteration 288 of 300, about 1.2 h from its horizon; it read that unfinished arm and, through a reader that resolved every run's stops via the rebuilt city schedule, read heavy rail 0 on the F32 result. The tenth follows the horizon it should have waited for. Judged on the rule: the tenth meets it; the ninth met its letter and not its purpose - one reading, two reports, and the only reading between them was the one the ninth could not wait for. The right cadence from here is the board's Next item 3: the eleventh after the next reading, not before.
same_family_note
The ninth and tenth are on the SAME family (F35) and different readings: it.288 unfinished through the broken reader (car +9.3 %, motorbike -5.4 %, heavy rail 10,052 / +54.0 %) against the it.300 result through the fixed reader (car +9.6 %, motorbike -5.6 %, heavy rail 10,092 / +54.6 %). The two readings agree to within 0.6 points on every mode - the F32 heavy-rail zero was the reader, not the run.

Recommendations, ranked

Ranked by what each would prevent or move × how cheap it is. A repeat tag marks one an earlier report already issued; the process audit counts them against this report too.

  1. Make the viewer's reading safe in the harness process: report_mode_ridership.report() returns its rows (no module-global LAST), the viewer computes at most one reading at a time and never redirects sys.stdout - or runs the reporter as a subprocess with --json.
    Two defects: redirect_stdout is process-global and the runner serves this viewer inside the arm (run_matsim.py:955), so a reading swallows the gate/ceiling/stall watchers' prints; concurrent readings race on LAST (run_view.py:524, :530).
    change: src/analyse/run_view.py:508-535; src/analyse/report_mode_ridership.py:486-510 · guard: a unit test that two readings on two runs cache distinct rows and that sys.stdout is untouched after a reading
  2. Land arm 0's findings in results/processed: re-run results_store.process('20260912T202242_300it_25pct', extract=True) under the bounded reader and log it; then make the close-out refuse to mark a run processed while _metrics.json / _fit.json are absent from processed/.
    The second result exists only in the raw cache (performance lane); a trim would delete the project's best evidence.
    change: src/run/results_store.py:202-283 · guard: check_package.py: every completed run in the index has _fit.json under processed/
  3. Read arm 0 at its horizon and spend the routers pair first (C.raptor.mode_cost_representation = mode_constant against absent), 250 iterations at 25 %, coverage read on both sides, then scoring -> choice set -> service quality -> submodes. repeat ×ninth #2, eighth, seventh True
    F5 router-scorer consistency is the factor ledger's top mover: light rail -73.9, heavy rail +54.6 and ferry -63.3 are decided in the raptor and no control has run (factors lane); every model-side control the reports asked for is built and unrun (history lane).
    change: cities/newcastle/overlays/runs/ (a pair overlay with answers_issues, RUN.gate.wall_ceiling_h set to the approval) · guard: coverage on both arms (#174); the reading at it.250, not it.100
  4. Rebuild the demand so that ride is seeded at the HTS share (B.mode.bound_passenger_placement) and the short end of destination placement has an observed shape - one rebuild, one family, then re-baseline. repeat ×ninth (roots) True
    Ride's 20.60 % target sits above its 19.11 % coverage fixed at the seed (#86); walk trips are 5.3x too long at build time (#30); no constant reaches either (factors H10, C-layer).
    change: src/build/build_activity_chains.py; cities/newcastle/registry/B_demand.json · guard: coverage >= target for every mode on the seed probe; the sub-1 km share against the HTS band

Appendix

Rubric: 5 = no finding in the area at HEAD; 4 = smells only; 3 = risks with a stated scenario; 2 = a defect the area's own checks miss; 1 = a defect that has reached an artefact. Reproduce: python .claude/skills/project-report/scripts/collect_{metrics,code_metrics,performance}.py <scratch>/metrics; the six lane prompts are the skill's phases 2-7; python .claude/skills/project-report/scripts/render_report.py <scratch> docs/reports/<stamp>_project_report.html. Search rounds: field 12 rounds / 40 calls; factors 9 rounds / 35 calls.
